scope: read-only statistical sanity check; no trading or notification use
availability_rule: available_at <= decision_time; missing is UNKNOWN; future is LEAKED_FEATURE
contamination_rule: report raw and participant-excluded flow; trigger-wallet trades are not exogenous

features.name: age_seconds
features.available_at_rule: launch event timestamp plus source latency
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if launch or latency timestamp is missing

features.name: log_return_to_decision
features.definition: log(price at decision / launch reference price)
features.event_time_rule: last valid event at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: event time plus source latency plus local derivation
features.participant_contamination_rule: price is market state; flow companion must be excluded separately

features.name: curve_progress
features.definition: normalized real or virtual reserve progress available before decision
features.event_time_rule: latest reserve event at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: event time plus source latency plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN for missing or protocol-inconsistent reserves
features.participant_contamination_rule: exclude protocol-generated flow from organic flow features

features.name: buy_volume_sol_raw
features.definition: cumulative buy quote volume through decision time
features.event_time_rule: buy events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest included event time plus source latency plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if amount is corrupt or unavailable
features.participant_contamination_rule: raw includes trigger participants and is not exogenous

features.name: buy_volume_sol_exogenous
features.definition: buy quote volume excluding trigger participant wallets
features.source: Pump.fun trade events plus point-in-time trigger set
features.event_time_rule: buy events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: max(event availability, trigger identity availability) plus derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if either flow or trigger set is unavailable

features.name: sell_volume_sol_exogenous
features.definition: sell quote volume excluding trigger participant wallets
features.source: Pump.fun trade events plus point-in-time trigger set
features.event_time_rule: sell events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: max(event availability, trigger identity availability) plus derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if either flow or trigger set is unavailable

features.name: net_flow_sol_exogenous
features.definition: exogenous buy volume minus exogenous sell volume
features.event_time_rule: events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest input availability plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if an input amount is invalid

features.name: trade_count_exogenous
features.definition: trade count excluding trigger participant wallets
features.source: Pump.fun trade events plus trigger set
features.event_time_rule: events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: max(event availability, trigger identity availability) plus derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if event identity is unavailable

features.name: unique_buyers_exogenous
features.definition: unique buy wallets excluding trigger participant wallets
features.source: Pump.fun trade events plus trigger set
features.event_time_rule: buy events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: max(event availability, trigger identity availability) plus derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if wallet identity is unavailable

features.name: new_buyer_acceleration_exogenous
features.definition: change in exogenous new-buyer count across the preceding frozen interval
features.event_time_rule: only intervals ending at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest interval event availability plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN when either interval is incomplete

features.name: buy_volume_acceleration_exogenous
features.definition: change in exogenous buy quote volume across the preceding frozen interval
features.event_time_rule: only intervals ending at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest interval event availability plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN when either interval is incomplete

features.name: sell_pressure_exogenous
features.definition: exogenous sell volume relative to exogenous buy volume
features.event_time_rule: events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest event availability plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN when volume inputs are incomplete

features.name: trade_size_concentration
features.definition: largest valid trade quote share through decision time
features.event_time_rule: events at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: latest event availability plus local derivation
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN when valid trade sizes are insufficient

features.name: participant_matured_count
features.definition: early participant candidates with fully matured pre-decision outcomes
features.event_time_rule: participant entry at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: reputation outcome maturity timestamp before decision time
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN is not failure; zero means observed and none matured
features.participant_contamination_rule: identity candidates are not economic actors without funding/bundle evidence

features.name: participant_best_posterior
features.definition: maximum uncertainty-shrunk posterior success estimate among matured candidates
features.event_time_rule: only participant entries at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: all contributing outcomes mature before decision time
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN when no candidate has matured history
features.participant_contamination_rule: flag creator-linked, bundle-linked, or sybil-like candidates; do not treat as bullish skill

features.name: participant_posterior_strength
features.definition: eligible matured observation count supporting participant posterior

features.name: participant_convergence_count
features.definition: distinct unproven participant/cohort arrivals within frozen entry window
features.source: ordered participant episodes and cohort helper
features.event_time_rule: arrivals at or before decision time
features.available_at_rule: identity and event data availability plus derivation
features.participant_contamination_rule: economic-cluster status remains UNKNOWN without funding or bundle evidence

features.name: migration_state
features.definition: migration status known by decision time
features.available_at_rule: migration event time plus source latency
features.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN if not observed; never infer migration from future PumpSwap rows
